hard_stops.logic: association information is required before HOA management can proceed
reserve fund is critically underfunded below 30% — special assessment or emergency funding required
association has missed more than 2 required filings — dissolution risk is imminent
individual ballot attribution must never be exposed — only aggregate totals are permitted in any output
ballot distribution must meet the statutory notice window for the jurisdiction before voting opens
community polls must be clearly labeled as non-binding — they cannot be presented as official HOA votes

soft_flags.logic: reserve funding is below the association's target threshold — plan contribution increases
assessment delinquency rate exceeds 10% — collection enforcement may be needed
developer-to-owner transition deadline is within 90 days — ensure turnover preparation
more than 90 days since last board meeting — governance compliance risk
vote-by date is within 5 days and quorum has not been reached — send reminder to all non-responding units
poll is expiring within 48 hours with less than 30% response rate — consider extending or sending reminder
California director elections and secret ballot matters require an independent inspector of elections (CA Civil Code §5110)
